Memory layout of tracking record, bucket, descriptor, global pools, per processor reserves, work item and cache handle.
Contracts of internal helpers for bucket selection, lookup, allocation, reserve filling, pressure handling, diagnostics, fixup dispatch, release, processor batch handling and offline handling.
Meaning and valid values of auxiliary marker and its expected and next arguments.
Call contexts, locking preconditions beyond bucket exclusion, interrupt and sleep rules, and ordering between early and late setup.
Precise semantics of external atomic, spin, interrupt flag, read once, race annotation, warning, error pointer, processor mask, per processor, branch, debug filesystem and sequence output helpers.
Decompressor routine signatures, return contracts, build dependent availability, and caller buffer management.

findings.text: Tracking facility offers address keyed lifecycle handling with descriptor context covering normal and stack initialization, activation with misuse signaling, deactivation, destruction, freeing, initialization assertion, and auxiliary marker progression.

Bulk validation examines a caller supplied address interval for tracked occupants, surfacing active occupants through diagnostics and recovery while discarding idle occupants, fronted by an enablement gated wrapper.

Boot handling prepares hash exclusions and a static reserve early, then later validates the facility, establishes a dedicated cache, migrates active tracking to dynamic entries, tunes reserve thresholds, publishes the cache, and optionally exposes statistics.

Reference handling provides plain and raw lock variants with standard and interrupt state preserving forms that decrement a shared counter and indicate whether the caller now owns the associated exclusion.

Format detection inspects leading input bytes against a small table of patterns, optionally reports the matching textual label, and yields the linked decompression routine which may be absent when that format lacks build support.
When the global enable flag is cleared the lifecycle operations and range validation take no table action, with activation indicating success and other operations ending silently without result.

Activation promotes initial and idle occupants to active with success indication, treats allocation exhaustion as silent success after pressure handling, and routes active, destroyed and untracked addresses to diagnostics with fixup mediated recovery deciding between success and an invalid argument signal.

Deactivation transitions initial, idle and plain active occupants to idle, while destroyed occupants, occupants carrying auxiliary state, and untracked addresses are surfaced through diagnostics without state change.

Destruction transitions placeholder, initial and idle occupants to destroyed, ignores untracked addresses silently, and surfaces active and destroyed occupants through diagnostics with active additionally offered to type specific destroy recovery.

Freeing detaches and releases placeholder, initial, idle and destroyed occupants and ignores untracked addresses silently, while active occupants are surfaced through diagnostics and offered to type specific free recovery without immediate release.

Initialization assertion guarantees tracked or statically known status by topping up reserve and allocating as needed, ending silently on success or memory pressure, and surfacing erroneous lookup through diagnostics and type specific assert recovery after rechecking enablement.

Auxiliary progression revises the secondary marker only for active occupants whose current marker matches the expected value, with mismatches, non active states and untracked addresses surfaced through diagnostics.

Range scanning covers the interval chunk by chunk across associated hash buckets, tallies visited entries, records maxima for per bucket chain length and total checked, and arms deferred release work when pending entries exist and no release is underway.

Statistics combine global handed out batches with per processor free counts clamped to avoid underflow to estimate usage, and report chain maxima, warning and fixup totals, pool levels, pending counts, and lifetime allocation and free totals.

Built in verification exercises representative lifecycle moves and misuse cases, confirms tracked state plus warning and fixup totals after each phase, disables the facility on any mismatch, then restores original counters and clears test context while reporting enablement.

Static replacement first fills the global reserve in fixed size batches, disconnects the boot list, then copies each hashed occupant into a freshly allocated entry linked in its place, releasing obtained batches and failing cleanly when batch allocation fails.

Late setup aborts when disabled or when verification fails, disables with a warning when cache creation or replacement fails, otherwise expands global reserve limits by processor scaled allowance, publishes the cache, enables its branch, and optionally registers processor offline handling.

Decrement helpers take a lock free conditional path when the counter remains above zero and only acquire the caller exclusion on the path toward zero, reporting ownership exactly when the decrement reaches zero and otherwise leaving the lock untouched.

Detection needs at least two input bytes, scans a sentinel ended table for an equal leading pair, returns the linked routine for the first match or absence when nothing matches, and always assigns the optional label output.

Each address bucket serializes lookup or allocation with state examination and mutation under an interrupt masked bucket exclusion that is always released before diagnostics, pressure reporting beyond the locked region, and recovery callbacks.
Early preparation initializes every bucket exclusion before any tracking activity and links the static reserve into the boot list while execution remains single threaded.
Reference helpers retain the caller exclusion only on the zero reaching outcome, with interrupt preserving forms protecting flag handling around the contended acquisition and release sequence.
Each compression entry pairs a two byte pattern with a textual label and a routine reference, collected in a boot resident read only table closed by an empty label entry.

Each coding group holds a limit table with one sentinel beyond the longest permitted code, a base table sized by that maximum, a permutation table sized by the symbol population, plus recorded shortest and longest lengths.

Decompression workspace joins output resume counters, input callback with buffered position and bit accumulation, cyclic redundancy tables and header plus running values, a resizable intermediate buffer, a large selector array, a group table array, an error flag, and frequency plus byte mapping tables.
Selftest placeholder surrounds an integer static marker with leading and trailing padding, allowing the same storage to exercise dynamic and static handling paths.

Object progress spans placeholder, initial, active, idle, destroyed and untracked placeholder conditions, where initial and idle may become active, active and idle may move among idle and destroyed as operation appropriate, destroyed rejects further lifecycle moves, and removal clears all but active.

Type recovery for init, activate, destroy and free resolves active misuse by deactivating then reissuing the original request, accepts untracked activation directly, and declines other state combinations.
Early entry readies bucket exclusions and stages the static object reserve on the boot list for use before general allocation is available.

Late entry validates, creates the object cache, replaces static tracking with dynamic entries, scales reserve watermarks by processor count, exposes the cache for use, and arms background and offline handling.
Statistics access presents read only counters through a dedicated directory file when enabled, with an inert alternative when filesystem support is uncompiled.
Concurrent allocation exhaustion can clear enablement while a bucket exclusion is held, so callers recheck enablement after unlocking before emitting diagnostics or invoking recovery.
Diagnostics and recovery run without bucket exclusion and recovery may call back into tracking operations, so bucket membership and occupant state can change across the unlocked recovery window.

Freed range handling unlinks idle occupants during bucket traversal and restarts traversal of the same bucket after handling an active occupant, using iteration that tolerates removal and recounts chain length.

Pattern facts in decimal byte pairs are first gzip thirty one with one hundred thirty nine and second gzip thirty one with one hundred fifty eight and bzip2 sixty six with ninety and lzma ninety three with zero and xz two hundred fifty three with fifty five and lzo one hundred thirty seven with seventy six and lz4 two with thirty three and zstd forty with one hundred eighty one.
Status facts use zero for success and descending negatives for terminal block, non data, truncated input, truncated output, data error, memory shortage, and obsolete input.

Sizing facts use six groups with fifty entries each and at most twenty code bits and two hundred fifty eight symbols where run symbols are zero and one and input output buffering is four thousand ninety six bytes.

Build facts include a preboot marker definition and a largest positive thirty two bit signed value of two billion one hundred forty seven million four hundred eighty three thousand six hundred forty seven.
Test wiring binds the label selftest with static detection and dedicated callbacks for init, activate, destroy and free recovery.
